title: AdminUi keeps about 17 sibling Option dialog slots; 'one box at a time' is a convention, not a type
trigger: Open the member dialog, then a deep link or agent step opens another admin box before the first closes
effect: Two boxes can both be Some; the shell shows one by priority and the other reappears when the first closes
fix: One AdminBox enum (None or one variant per box) so opening a box replaces the last

title: pending_deep_link is a single slot; queueing a link replaces the one waiting
trigger: Two links reach queue_deep_link/queue_outside_link before pump_deep_link runs, or one waits behind the lock while a second is queued
effect: The first link is dropped without a note
fix: A small queue of QueuedLink, or a note when a waiting link is replaced

title: Dismissing the style editor while StyleSave::Sent is in flight drops the only tracker for that request
trigger: Tap Create in the AI style editor, then Back before the server answers
effect: The style is created but no toast shows and the new style is not auto-selected (select_on_arrival never set)
fix: Keep the request on AiComposeOpen so a Back keeps waiting for the answer

title: open_ai_style_preview overwrites an existing AiStylePreview whose stage holds a request (LookingUp, Adding or Removing)
trigger: Open a style link while a preview is Adding, then open a second style link
effect: The first preview's request is no longer tracked; its add still completes on the server, and the toast then comes from the generic path
fix: Refuse or close the earlier preview before replacing it

title: The session source is three separate fields: live: Option<LiveConnect>, demo_session: Option<Box<Session>> and credentials
trigger: session() prefers live over demo_session; pane_mode() and current_auth() each repeat the same precedence
effect: A code path that sets both, or clears only one, reads the wrong session

title: composer_ui.ai_button_since is an Option<Instant> used as a 'blink started' flag and reset from render
trigger: ai_compose_button() sets it on first show and clears it when the button is not wanted
effect: None today; the animation start is state mutated from render
fix: Presence stage owned by the button (like surface_reveal::Presence)

title: The link-handler read has two holders: LinkHandlerRecheck::{Idle,Rechecking} and link_handler_watch: Option<Task>
trigger: Make Quill the default handler, which starts recheck_link_handler; opening the page also starts repaint_when_link_handler_read
effect: Two task slots track one background read
fix: One LinkHandlerWatch enum (Idle, Reading, Rechecking) holding the task

title: icon_svg caches a negative verdict by path and reads the file on the UI thread under a global lock
trigger: A bot icon file exists but is still partly downloaded when first read
effect: looks_like_svg fails on the partial bytes and the icon stays missing until the 64-entry cache clears; a 256 KB read blocks the frame
fix: Cache only when the download is complete; read on a background task
